percentChangeFromPrevious.label: Percent change from previous
percentChangeFromPrevious.description: Calculates the percentage change from the previous row value.

differenceFromPrevious.label: Difference from previous
differenceFromPrevious.description: Subtracts the previous row value from the current row value.

percentOfPreviousValue.label: Percent of previous value
percentOfPreviousValue.description: Shows the current value as a percentage of the previous row value.

percentOfColumnTotal.label: Percent of column total
percentOfColumnTotal.description: Shows each value as a percentage of the column total.

rankInColumn.label: Rank in column
rankInColumn.description: Ranks values within the column from highest to lowest.

runningTotal.label: Running total
runningTotal.description: Calculates a cumulative sum across rows.

windowFunction.label: Window function
windowFunction.description: Applies SQL window functions (e.g., ROW_NUMBER, PERCENT_RANK) to the result set.

formula.label: Apply calculation to the totals
formula.description: Runs the formula over the totals of the columns it references. Best for ratios and percentages.

sumOfRows.label: Sum of the row values
sumOfRows.description: Adds up the calculation's value from every row. Best for row-level transformations.

none.label: No totals
none.description: Shows no totals for this calculation.
